# driver.js 1.3.6

The guided tour of a screen's settings page (`broker/static/config_tour.js`) uses
[driver.js](https://driverjs.com) by Kamran Ahmed, MIT licensed (LICENSE).

`driver.js.iife.js` and `driver.css` are the `dist/` files of the npm package
`driver.js@1.3.6`, copied as they are. To update, copy the same two files from the
new version's package and change the version here.
